en: Fixed `/logout`, `claude auth logout` and `claude mcp remove` reporting success, and changes to trust, consent or MCP settings being dropped with no word, when the config file could not be updated on a shared network home directory
zh: 修复了在共享网络主目录上无法更新配置文件时，`/logout`、`claude auth logout` 和 `claude mcp remove` 仍报告成功，以及对信任、同意或 MCP 设置的更改被静默丢弃的问题
